backlink_pages.title: Product Brief — CSV Export Limit
backlink_pages.author: Priya Sharma
backlink_pages.excerpt: Problem statement Board CSV export truncates multi-line description fields at 255 characters. Related issue is NMB-115. Support portal export can double-fire on slow connections (NMS-59). Hypothesis

comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Reopening — the same trace showed up again this morning.

content.text: Reopening — the same trace showed up again this morning.

comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Root cause is the cache key missing the workspace id.

content.text: Root cause is the cache key missing the workspace id.
Steps to reproduce: open export never finishes with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
